title: Why Spain Stopped: The Housing Strike & Snap Election
description: A fast-paced explainer of Spain's historic general strike over the housing crisis, the political clashes ahead of the November 2026 snap election, and how a deadly train crash shifted everything.

characters.name: Everyman
characters.look: Cartoon man in his late 30s, messy brown hair, round glasses, wearing a simple blue work shirt and jeans. Always carries a small notebook.
characters.voice: Male, late 30s, neutral accent, mid-pitch, conversational pace, slightly raspy timbre.

characters.name: Union Leader
characters.look: Cartoon woman in her early 50s with sharp features, dark curly hair tied back, wearing a red utility vest over a grey sweater. Carries a battered megaphone.
characters.voice: Female, late 40s, Madrid accent, slightly lower pitch, firm timbre, fast and energetic pace.

characters.name: Tech Analyst
characters.look: Cartoon man in his late 20s with short blonde hair, wearing a teal tech hoodie and holding a tablet. Looks perpetually surprised by data.
characters.voice: Male, late 20s, light British accent, high pitch, clear timbre, rapid but precise pace.

characters.name: Mayor Pedro
characters.look: Respectful cartoon caricature of a seasoned politician. Grey hair slicked back, sharp navy suit, red tie, holding a rolled-up decree paper.
characters.voice: Male, 60s, deep Spanish accent, low pitch, resonant timbre, measured and confident pace.

characters.name: Rival Miguel
characters.look: Cartoon man in his early 40s with a sharp jawline, wearing a crisp white shirt and dark blazer. Always has a clipboard tucked under one arm.
characters.voice: Male, early 40s, crisp Southern European accent, mid-high pitch, bright timbre, brisk pace.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Millions of Spaniards just walked off the job. Why is the entire country hitting pause right before a historic vote?
